description: A solar plant: the point of interconnection and everything behind it. It has no feed of its own; its numbers are the sum of its assets'.
passing: A site has no remote test of its own; its status is its assets' statuses.

description: Turns its strings' direct current into grid alternating current; the asset whose output the KPIs count.
passing: The endpoint answers within the timeout with a sample whose every field is in range, power at or under the inverter's rated_kw with 1% over allowed, near zero at night, at least 0.75 of what its rating and the sun promise in daylight, and never the same non-zero value for half an hour.

description: A series chain of panels feeding one inverter input. It has no feed of its own; its current is read through its inverter.
passing: A string has no remote test of its own; a fault on it is raised from its inverter's data.

description: A single-axis tracker turning a row of panels to follow the sun, stowing flat in high wind.
passing: The endpoint answers within the timeout with an angle in range that changes over the day.

description: The revenue meter at the point of interconnection: the energy the plant is paid for.
passing: The endpoint answers within the timeout with an energy count at or above zero that never falls from one sample to the next.

description: A weather station: plane-of-array irradiance and temperature, the denominator of the performance ratio.
passing: The endpoint answers within the timeout with irradiance and temperature both in range.
